summary: community.general deprecated keycloak redirects for component_info, group, identity_provider, realm, realm_info, realm_key, realm_keys_metadata_info and realm_localization, for removal in 16.0.0.
questions: What module manages Keycloak groups after the change?
How do I migrate keycloak_identity_provider tasks?

answer_card.title: community.general keycloak redirects deprecated (realms)
answer_card.answer_md:
These community.general **redirects** to `middleware_automation.keycloak` are deprecated and will be removed in **community.general 16.0.0**. Switch your tasks to the FQCN `middleware_automation.keycloak.<module>` now (install it with `ansible-galaxy collection install middleware_automation.keycloak`).

- `keycloak_component_info`, `keycloak_group`, `keycloak_identity_provider`
- `keycloak_realm`, `keycloak_realm_info`, `keycloak_realm_key`, `keycloak_realm_keys_metadata_info`, `keycloak_realm_localization`
